content_fields.title: Verify that all data in transit is encrypted using a secure TLS channel
content_fields.description: Require TLS on the database connection and verify the server certificate.
content_fields.finding: The PostgreSQL engine is created from a URL with no sslmode, so the database connection can run in plaintext.
criteria: A CA certificate path is configured and the server certificate is validated.
A plaintext connection attempt is refused by the server.
